name: Kota Tua and Muaro
tagline: The Dutch old town by the river mouth
description: Padang's historic quarter along the Batang Arau where the colonial trading houses and the Chinatown shophouses still stand, some restored and many not. The fishing harbour is at the end of it and the hill of Gunung Padang rises across the water. It is the most atmospheric part of the city.
bestFor: Stays that want the old town and the harbour rather than a modern district
pros: Colonial and Chinatown architecture along the river
Fishing harbour and boats to the Mentawais nearby
cons: Many buildings are in poor repair
Low-lying and prone to flooding in heavy rain

name: Padang Barat and the City Centre
tagline: The commercial core, banks, markets and the mosque
description: The central business district around Pasar Raya market and the Grand Mosque of West Sumatra, holding the banks, the offices, the main shops and the transport connections. It is where practical business gets done and where most of the mid-range accommodation sits.
bestFor: Anyone who needs banks, markets and transport within a short ride
pros: All services, banks and the main market close by
Best internet connectivity in the city
Widest choice of rooms and apartments
cons: Flooding during the worst of the rain

name: Purus and the Beachfront
tagline: Along Padang beach, where the city watches the sunset
description: The strip along the city beach, with a wide promenade, food stalls and the sunset crowd that gathers every evening. The sea here is rough and not for swimming, but the walk is the city's main public space and there are guesthouses and small hotels along it.
bestFor: Stays that want the promenade and the sunset as the daily routine
pros: Long seafront promenade and evening food stalls
Sea breeze and more open air than the centre
Walking distance to the city centre
cons: The sea here is unsafe for swimming
Directly exposed in a tsunami zone

name: Air Tawar and the University District
tagline: North of the centre, around Universitas Negeri Padang
description: The northern district built around the state university, with student boarding houses, cheap warungs and a young population. Rents are the lowest in the city and it sits on higher ground than the coastal strip, which locally is a consideration that matters.
bestFor: Budget stays wanting student prices and higher ground
pros: Dense cheap eating around the campus

name: Bungus and the Southern Coast
tagline: A quiet bay south of the city, with boats to the islands
description: A sheltered bay about twenty kilometres south where the coast road runs between hills and sea, with fishing villages, calm water suitable for swimming and boats out to the small islands offshore. It is quiet, green and a long way from the city's traffic.
bestFor: Stays that want calm water and hills, with the city at arm's length
pros: Sheltered bay with water calm enough to swim
cons: Thirty to forty minutes into Padang
Transport depends on your own vehicle
